text: In seed 22 at N=256 with m2 fixed, the best force margin is 0.002, at layer 0, at every checkpoint from step 500 to 3000, even though val_mse_ratio falls to 0.20 and layer-1 distance R2 is 0.95. Is force below its control at every layer? If so, how does this model reach next-step accuracy with no linearly decodable 1/r^2 beyond what a random model already gives?
